note: The golden corpus. Ids are stable and referenced by queries.json, so an item's text may be edited but its id must not change.

items.content: We chose PostgreSQL with pgvector for Brain Core storage instead of Neo4j, because the graph stays small and running one database is less operational work than two.
Brain Gateway spawns `claude -p` as a subprocess per request rather than calling the Messages API directly, so the CLI's MCP wiring and session resume come for free.
Scope is decided only in the Gateway and travels to Core in the X-Scope header. No model output may ever set a scope.
Retrieval uses reciprocal rank fusion over three branches (vector, full-text, graph) rather than a weighted score blend, because the branch scores share no scale.
The write-back queue is a Postgres table polled by a worker. We deliberately did not add Redis or RabbitMQ for a queue that sees fewer than a thousand jobs a day.
Memory items are never deleted by the system. A newer item sets superseded_by on the older one, so every change is traceable and reversible.
The UI is plain HTML and JavaScript with no build step, because a build pipeline for a debugging tool costs more than it returns.
Embeddings default to the hash provider so a fresh checkout works offline; transformers is opt-in via DAI_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER.
Full-text search uses the 'simple' Postgres text config, not 'english', because the store holds Vietnamese and English side by side and an English stemmer mangles Vietnamese.
Dùng JWT HS256 cho auth giữa UI và Gateway, không dùng session cookie, vì Gateway là stateless và có thể chạy nhiều instance.
The p95 latency target for the Core /search endpoint is 500 milliseconds.
The Gateway pre-fetch calls Core /search with a budget of about 1000 tokens and injects the result through --append-system-prompt.
The MCP server exposes exactly four tools: memory_search, memory_graph_explore, memory_get and memory_write.
Concurrent claude subprocesses are capped by a semaphore; the default limit is 8 and it is set with GATEWAY_MAX_CONCURRENCY.
Each conversation gets its own working directory and its own CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR so one session's config cannot leak into another's.
The RRF constant k is 60, the value used by the original reciprocal rank fusion paper.
Branch weights are vector 1.0, full-text 0.9 and graph 0.6.
Graph expansion runs at most 3 hops and stops at 200 nodes, whichever comes first.
The default dedupe threshold is cosine similarity 0.93; above it the reconciler treats two items as the same memory restated.
Ngưỡng confidence tối thiểu cho item do write-back tạo ra là 0.6; thấp hơn thì bị loại bỏ, không lưu.
To run the eval set: pnpm build, then pnpm eval. It prints recall@5, recall@10, MRR@10 and the p50/p95 latency of /search.
To apply database migrations run `pnpm migrate`. It picks pgvector automatically when the extension is installable and falls back to real[] storage otherwise.
To bring everything up locally: docker compose up in infra/, which starts Postgres, Core, MCP and Gateway.
To undo one conversation's write-back, send DELETE /conversations/{id}/memory to Core. It removes every item that run created and nothing a person wrote.
To debug bad retrieval, open the memory explorer in the UI, search the same query, and read the fusion report to see which branch was degraded.
Để thêm một embedding provider mới, implement interface EmbeddingProvider trong core/src/embed và đăng ký nó trong createEmbeddingProvider.
Prefer TypeScript over Python for every DAI Brain service, so one type system covers the whole stack.
Keep dependencies minimal. A hand-written 120-line router is preferred over pulling in Express.
Tôi thích comment giải thích lý do (why) hơn là mô tả lại code (what).
Error messages should say what to do next, not only what went wrong.
Considered Qdrant and Weaviate for the vector store before settling on pgvector. Both were fine; neither justified a second datastore.
The hash embedder is lexical only. Recall numbers measured with it are a floor, not a forecast of production quality.
Spawning the CLI costs a few seconds of startup per request. If that becomes the bottleneck, swap the Runner for the Claude Agent SDK; the UI will not notice.
Write-back with a low confidence floor produced junk memories in early testing. Start strict and loosen with evidence.
Tree-sitter grammars from the old plugin are not used by Brain Core. Core indexes conversation memory, not source code.
infra/docker-compose.yml defines four services: postgres (pgvector/pgvector:pg16), core, mcp and gateway, on a shared bridge network.
shared/src/events.ts defines the six SSE event types: message.delta, tool.start, tool.result, citation, message.done and error.
core/migrations/001_init.sql creates memory_items, entities, relations, item_entities, conversations, messages and writeback_jobs.
The privacy filter rejects an item outright when it contains a provider API key, and masks assignment-shaped secrets like DB_PASSWORD=... instead.
Search results are cached for 30 seconds keyed by scope plus query plus options, and the cache is cleared on every write.
